claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows the horizontal seam on the side plates, which is characteristic of the Slim model.
Warranty seals on the rear are not shown.
Requires a stress test under load which cannot be seen in photos.
The rear ports are not shown and the console is not shown powered on.
Only one controller is shown; its authenticity cannot be confirmed from a distance.
The receipt is not included in the witness report.

risks.risk: Console may be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be faulty or unable to read discs.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: As a Digital Edition console with a broken drive.

risks.risk: The HDMI port or internal APU may have intermittent failure/overheating.
risks.proof: A continuous 15-minute video of gameplay showing stable output.
risks.if_unproven: As a unit requiring motherboard repair.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller connected to a gamepad tester or navigating menus without drift.

proof_requests: Video of the console powered on and connected to a screen.
Photo of the rear ports and warranty seals.
Video of a disc being inserted and the game loading.
Photo of the UK receipt mentioned by the seller.
Video showing the console connecting to the internet and PSN.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the item as a PS5 Slim with a disc drive and one controller. It can be priced based on its worst-case functional state until further proof is provided.
